name: Issy & Co. Active Skin Tint
description: Lightweight skin tint in shade ST3 that gives a very natural second-skin finish. This product has been gently used only a few times and still has about 90% of the product remaining. Perfect for everyday wear if you want light coverage that evens out the skin tone while still letting your natural skin show through.

name: BLK Cosmetics Creamy All-Over Paint
description: Multipurpose creamy pigment in the shade Fig that can be used on the cheeks, lips, and even eyelids. The texture blends smoothly and creates a soft flushed look on the skin. This item has only been used twice and is still in excellent condition despite not having the original box.

name: Happy Skin Lip Mallow Tint
description: Soft matte lip tint in the shade Vibin' that provides a comfortable velvet finish without drying the lips. The color is flattering for everyday makeup looks and works well with both natural and glam styles. The product has only been swatched once and sanitized properly before listing.

name: Barenbliss Bloomatte Stay Confident Lip Cream
description: A long-lasting matte lip cream in shade 03 Peach Makes Perfect that delivers a smooth and pigmented finish in just one swipe. This lipstick is completely brand new, unopened, and still sealed. It has a lightweight texture that feels comfortable on the lips even after several hours of wear.

name: Popique Soft Blur Powder Blush
description: Powder blush in the shade Rosy Flush that creates a soft-focus blurred effect on the cheeks. The formula is finely milled and blends effortlessly, giving a natural healthy glow. The product has been lightly used but there are no dents or damage to the powder surface.

name: Issy & Co. Brow Refiner
description: Precision eyebrow pencil in shade Ash Brown that helps create natural-looking brows with fine hair-like strokes. The formula glides smoothly without tugging on the skin and stays in place throughout the day. Approximately 80 percent of the product remains and the spoolie brush is still intact.

name: BLK Cosmetics Daydream Airy Matte Foundation
description: Airy matte liquid foundation in shade Vanilla that offers medium buildable coverage while maintaining a lightweight feel on the skin. It works well for normal to oily skin types and helps control shine. The bottle has only been used three times and the pump dispenser functions perfectly.

name: Happy Skin Dew Cooling Sunscreen + Makeup Base
description: Hybrid sunscreen and makeup base with SPF 50+ that protects the skin while providing a refreshing cooling sensation. It also acts as a primer to help makeup apply more smoothly and last longer throughout the day. The tube is about 95 percent full and was opened just last month.

name: Happy Skin Mini Mallows Tint
description: Moisturizing matte lip tint with a lightweight velvet finish that feels comfortable even after long hours of wear. The formula contains nourishing ingredients that help prevent dryness while still delivering strong pigment. Ideal for quick everyday touch-ups and natural-looking lip color.

name: Vice Co. Dew-it-all Liquid Blush
description: Liquid blush that blends easily into the skin to create a dewy flushed look. A small amount goes a long way and can be layered depending on how intense you want the color to appear. The formula has a slightly earthy scent and dries down to a natural skin-like finish.

name: Colourette Coloursnap Lipstick
description: Highly pigmented lipstick that delivers vibrant color payoff in a single swipe. The creamy formula glides easily across the lips and feels comfortable without emphasizing dryness or cracks. Suitable for both casual everyday looks and more dramatic evening makeup styles.

name: Sunnies Face Airblush
description: Cream blush that gives a soft diffused flush to the cheeks. The lightweight formula blends effortlessly using either fingers or a brush and melts naturally into the skin. Perfect for achieving a subtle youthful glow without looking overly powdery or heavy.

name: Careline Oil Control Powder
description: Compact powder designed to control excess oil and reduce shine throughout the day. The texture is smooth and lightweight so it sets foundation without looking cakey. Great for students or anyone who needs an affordable everyday powder for quick touch-ups.

name: Detail Cosmetics Fresh Filter Foundation
description: Medium coverage liquid foundation that provides a natural skin-like finish while helping blur imperfections. It blends well using either a sponge or brush and lasts several hours before needing a touch-up. The bottle has been used only once for testing purposes.

name: Ever Bilena Advance Lip Define
description: Long-wearing lip liner designed to define the lips and prevent lipstick from feathering outside the lip line. The pencil has a creamy texture that makes it easy to apply while still maintaining precise control. Ideal for pairing with matte or glossy lip products.
